# Requirements Checklist: Parameter Exploration & Sharing

**Purpose**: Standard-depth requirements-quality pass across spec.md's
three user stories (sweep, permalink, failure presets) before
`/speckit.tasks` -- validates the requirements themselves (completeness,
clarity, consistency, measurability, coverage), not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist`
command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is a UI-reachability requirement defined for the failure-preset picker (e.g., visible/reachable from every pipeline step), matching User Story 3's Independent Test wording, anywhere in the Functional Requirements section? [Gap, Spec §FR-009] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: FR-009 now states the preset picker MUST be reachable from any pipeline step.
- [x] CHK002 Is a UI-reachability or placement requirement defined for the "Generate permalink" control (which step(s) it must be available from)? [Gap, Spec §FR-005] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: FR-005 now states the control MUST be reachable from any pipeline step.
- [x] CHK003 Is a "reset to defaults" requirement defined for a permalink-loaded (non-preset, non-swept) state, or is FR-010's scope limited to preset-loaded/swept states only? [Gap, Spec §FR-010] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: FR-010 broadened to "reachable at all times, regardless of how the current state was reached."
- [x] CHK004 Is there a requirement establishing that the sweep control itself is available in Real Mode, given FR-001 scopes its existence to "(Simulated Mode)" while FR-003 and Acceptance Scenario 4 both assume a Real Mode sweep exists to be confirmed and run? [Gap/Conflict, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: FR-001 rewritten to state the sweep control operates in both modes, Real Mode gated by FR-003.
- [x] CHK005 Are performance/responsiveness expectations defined for the Simulated Mode sweep (9 synchronous re-computations), given the Independent Test's "no manual re-running required" language implies some responsiveness bar? [Gap, Spec User Story 1] -- **Dismissed 2026-08-10**: the sweep is 9 synchronous passes over a handful of chunks/words, the same order of magnitude as one existing Retrieval computation already re-run per keystroke elsewhere in this module. No prior spec in this project (001, 002) sets a numeric micro-perf NFR for comparable synchronous computations either; inventing one here would be untestable padding, not a real gap.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "flat (low-sensitivity) curve" (FR-004) quantified with a specific threshold, or left to implementation discretion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: FR-004 now defines it as a top-1 score range below 0.02 across all sweep points.
- [x] CHK007 Is "cost" in FR-003 ("estimated call count and cost are shown") defined -- does it mean a dollar estimate, or is it synonymous with the call-count estimate? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: subsumed by CHK009's fix -- FR-003/AS4/SC-005 all now say "call count," no "cost" language remains.
- [x] CHK008 Is the boundary of "an active, in-progress sweep" (Edge Cases) defined precisely enough to determine whether a Real Mode sweep awaiting cost confirmation (not yet running) counts as "in-progress" for permalink-generation purposes? [Ambiguity, Spec Edge Cases] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: Edge Cases bullet now explicitly states both awaiting-confirmation and actively-running count as "in-progress."

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Does FR-003/Acceptance Scenario 4's requirement to show an estimated "cost" (dollar figure) conflict with spec 002's own FR-010 precedent, which explicitly scoped Real Mode cost indication to call-count only and deferred dollar-cost estimation to Milestone 4 (roadmap.md)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-003 vs. spec 002 §FR-010, roadmap.md Milestone 4] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: FR-003, Acceptance Scenario 4, and SC-005 all rewritten to "call count" only, explicitly deferring dollar cost to Milestone 4.
- [x] CHK010 Is the "chosen output metric" language in User Story 1 and FR-001 consistent with FR-002's specific mention of a single plotted metric, given the sweep is now scoped to one fixed metric only? [Consistency, Spec User Story 1 vs §FR-001/FR-002] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: US1's narrative, Independent Test, and Acceptance Scenario 1 all now say "the top-1 similarity score" directly, dropping the "a chosen metric (e.g. ...)" hedging language.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK011 Is SC-001 ("at least one range where the output metric changes meaningfully and at least one range where it stays flat") measurable against a specific, named document/query combination, or does it assume this property holds for an arbitrary/undocumented combination? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: verified empirically against the live `chunkText`/`embed` pipeline for the "coffee" doc's first sample query and tied to concrete numbers in SC-001's text (flat: chunk sizes 70-85, delta ~0.003; meaningful change: 45-60, delta ~0.09).
- [x] CHK012 Is SC-005's "100% of Real Mode sweeps requiring more than one real API call" measurable as a meaningful boundary case, given the fixed sweep range makes every possible sweep require more than one call by construction (the excluded case can never occur)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: reworded to "Every Real Mode sweep -- which... always requires more than one real API call --" removing the vacuous percentage framing.

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK013 Are requirements defined for generating a permalink while a failure preset (rather than a sweep) is the most recently loaded state -- does the same document/parameter-exclusion logic apply uniformly? [Coverage, Gap] -- **Dismissed 2026-08-10**: permalink generation is purely state-based (reads current parameter values), not history-based -- it has no notion of "how" the current values were reached (typed, preset-loaded, or swept), so no special-casing is needed or possible to omit. FR-005/FR-007's exclusion rules already apply uniformly by construction.
- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for the sweep's behavior if the active query is empty or unset at the moment a sweep is activated? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap] -- **Dismissed 2026-08-10**: `RetrievalStep.tsx`'s existing Milestone 1 behavior seeds a sample query on mount before any control (including a future sweep control) is interactive, so an empty query at sweep-activation time cannot occur in practice -- not a new gap this feature introduces.
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements defined for what a learner sees if they open a permalink whose `mode=real` parameter is present but the real API calls subsequently fail, distinct from simply not yet being confirmed? [Coverage, Gap] -- **Dismissed 2026-08-10**: a real-call failure after a permalink activates Real Mode is identical to any other Real Mode call failure -- spec 002 FR-007's existing error-banner-plus-fallback requirement already governs it unchanged; no new behavior class is introduced by arriving at Real Mode via a permalink instead of the toggle.

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Is behavior defined for a permalink containing a syntactically malformed or out-of-range parameter value (e.g. a chunk size outside the slider's bounds, a threshold outside 0-1)? [Edge Case, Gap] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: new Edge Cases bullet + FR-008 amendment -- an invalid parameter falls back to its default without invalidating the rest of the link.
- [x] CHK017 Is behavior defined for generating a permalink before any query/question has been entered? [Edge Case, Gap] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: new Edge Cases bullet -- an empty question is validly encodable (empty/omitted `q`), not a failure case.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK018 Are accessibility requirements for the failure-preset picker and reset-to-defaults control specified with the same rigor as the sweep curve's keyboard-operability requirement added during Clarification, or only the sweep curve's? [Consistency, Coverage, Spec Clarifications] -- **Dismissed 2026-08-10**: the sweep curve needed an explicit spec-level requirement because `/speckit.clarify` surfaced a genuine open design question (SVG-shape-with-tabindex vs. native-button focus model) -- constitution.md's Principle VII is an explicit project-wide baseline applying to every control regardless of per-feature spec text ("a baseline requirement for every module, not a follow-up task"). The preset picker and reset control are ordinary `<button>`/selector elements, the same class of control as `ChunkingStep.tsx`'s existing strategy toggle, which already get keyboard operability for free and fall under `tests/a11y/`'s established coverage pattern -- no comparable open design question exists for them.
- [x] CHK019 Is the Assumption that Milestone 2 (Real Mode) is not "strictly required" for this milestone reconciled with FR-003's Real-Mode-specific requirement -- i.e., is FR-003 understood to be inert/out-of-scope entirely when Real Mode isn't present? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions vs §FR-003] -- **Dismissed 2026-08-10**: FR-003's own opening clause ("When a sweep is run in Real Mode...") already makes it conditionally inert when Real Mode isn't used -- no textual conflict exists between it and the Assumption; this item found none on inspection.
- [x] CHK020 Is a requirement/acceptance-criteria ID cross-reference scheme established linking each User Story's Acceptance Scenarios to their corresponding FR/SC numbers, to make traceability auditable? [Traceability, Gap] -- **Dismissed 2026-08-10**: neither spec 001 nor spec 002 in this project uses an inline Acceptance-Scenario-to-FR/SC ID scheme either; introducing one uniquely for 003 would be inconsistent with established project convention rather than a genuine gap specific to this spec.
